intro: Flexibility meets flair with the Salt and Pepper. Its sleek extendable design transforms effortlessly to accommodate guests, offering a polished solution for both intimate meals and grand gatherings​.

features.title: Flexible design for every meal
features.text: Extra guests? No problem. The 4-to-6 seater extendable mechanism offers flexibility, making room for everyone when you need it most.

features.title: Sleek glass and wood combo
features.text: Modern style meets durability. Combining black tempered glass with MDF creates a sleek, refined look that holds up to daily use.

features.title: Space-saving when compact
features.text: Small space? No problem—the compact design offers space-saving convenience without sacrificing style.

features.title: Scratch-resistant surface
features.text: Stay worry-free—UV-coated surfaces resist scratches, keeping your table looking fresh through everyday use.

features.title: Strong, stable base
features.text: Built to last—the strong metal understructure offers exceptional stability and durability for years to come.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
